class.name: SteamAudioServer
class.brief_description: This is a singleton that handles all SteamAudio global state. You should not interact with it directly.

method.name: save_scene_obj
method.description: Writes the committed acoustic scene to an OBJ file, with a sibling MTL, so you can open it in a modelling tool and compare it against the visible level. Useful when occlusion or reverb does not match what you see. Only works while the game is running, since the scene is built from the geometry nodes as they enter the tree.
